description: This file implements a generic controller for Kubernetes custom resources, including setup, event handling, worker routines, and reconciliation logic.

classes.name: controller
classes.description: A generic controller struct parameterized by runtime.Object, managing event handling, workqueue, and reconciliation.

classes.name: ControllerOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the controller, including name and number of worker routines.

methods.name: Informer
methods.description: Returns the informer associated with the controller.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller, processes events, and manages worker routines until context cancellation.

methods.name: HasSynced
methods.description: Checks if the controller's internal tracker has synchronized.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Worker routine that processes items from the workqueue and calls reconcile.

methods.name: reconcile
methods.description: Performs reconciliation for a given resource key, fetching the object and invoking the reconciler.
